game.title: Mahjong Deck
game.tagline: Match pairs, pick a card, clear five stacks

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.effect: Re-deal remaining tiles; no heart lost.

undo.name: Undo
undo.effect: Put the last cleared pair back.

wild.name: Wild
wild.effect: Next pair: any two free tiles.

heal.name: Heal
heal.effect: Restore 1 lost heart (max 5). Tap to use; kept at full health.

combo.name: Combo
combo.effect: Double points for the next 3 pairs.

reward.title: Stage cleared!
reward.pick: Choose a card to add to your hand
reward.finale: Final stack: 64 tiles. Start with at least 3 hearts.

a11y.help: A tile is playable when nothing covers it from above and at least one side, left or right, has no tile touching it. Tap a playable tile then a second playable tile of the same type to clear the pair. Tapping a blocked tile costs nothing. Matching two different tiles loses a heart. Arrow keys move focus between playable tiles, Enter or Space selects, keys 1 to 4 play your hand cards, Z plays Undo, H plays Hint, S plays Shuffle.
a11y.stageClear: Stage cleared, bonus {n} points. Choose a card.
a11y.reshuffleCard: No moves left. A shuffle card reshuffled the tiles.
a11y.reshuffleHeart: No moves left. Tiles reshuffled, {n} hearts left.
a11y.cardHint: Hint: a matching pair is highlighted.
a11y.cardWild: Wild ready: your next match can be any two tiles.
a11y.cardCombo: Combo card: the next three matches score double.
a11y.titleDemo: Title screen: the game is playing itself.

coach.step1: Tap a bright tile. Dark tiles are blocked: uncover them and free one side.
coach.step2: Tap another bright tile with the same picture. A wrong pair costs one heart.
coach.step3: Tap a card below to use it once. Hint lights up a pair; Shuffle costs no heart.
